Name: Justus of Corinth
Summary: Justus was a man at Corinth who worshipped God, whose house joined hard to the synagogue. Paul left the synagogue and preached next door at Justus' house after the Jews opposed him. He is distinct from Joseph Barsabbas, also called Justus.
KeyStory: Paul moved next door to the synagogue, into the house of Justus, and the church met at the wall between.
LifeLesson: When one door closes, the house next door opens. Justus' wall adjoined the synagogue and held the gospel.
